products.body_html:
The three things every new planted tank needs, in one order: the 20in Aurora LED, the 5-piece scaping set, and the master liquid test kit.

  • Includes: Aurora 20in LED, 5-pc tool set, master test kit
  • Saves: $42 vs buying separately
  • Best for: First planted tank

products.body_html:
A complete CO2 front end: dual-gauge regulator with solenoid, inline atomiser, and glass drop checker with reference solution.

  • Includes: Regulator + solenoid, inline atomiser, drop checker
  • Saves: $40 vs buying separately
  • Note: Cylinder not included

products.title: Aurora 24/7 Planted Tank LED - 30in
products.body_html:
Full-spectrum LED bar for planted tanks 30-36in. Programmable 24/7 sunrise-to-moonlight cycle, adjustable white/red/blue/green channels, extendable brackets.

  • Length: 30-36 in (extendable)
  • Spectrum: Full RGB + 6500K white
  • Power: 24 W
  • Modes: 24/7 auto, DIY custom, manual
  • Rating: IP68 waterproof

products.title: Aurora 24/7 Planted Tank LED - 20in
products.body_html:
The 20-24in Aurora. Same full-spectrum engine and 24/7 programmable cycle in a shorter bar for nano and mid-size aquascapes.

  • Length: 20-24 in (extendable)
  • Spectrum: Full RGB + 6500K white
  • Power: 16 W
  • Modes: 24/7 auto, DIY custom, manual
  • Rating: IP68 waterproof

products.title: Clip-On Nano Grow Light
products.body_html:
Clip-mount full-spectrum light for tanks up to 16in. Gooseneck arm, three brightness levels, built-in timer. The easiest upgrade for a nano planted tank.

  • Fits: Rimless or rimmed, up to 16 in
  • Spectrum: 6500K full spectrum
  • Power: 10 W
  • Timer: 3 / 9 / 12 hr auto
  • Arm: Flexible gooseneck
_specs: Rimless or rimmed, up to 16 in

products.title: Aurora Pro 42W - 36-48in
products.body_html:
For large planted displays. 42W across 36-48in with independent channel control and a full programmable day curve.

  • Length: 36-48 in (extendable)
  • Spectrum: Full RGB + 6500K white
  • Power: 42 W
  • Modes: 24/7 auto, DIY custom
  • Rating: IP68 waterproof

products.title: Sunrise Timer Controller
products.body_html:
Inline controller that adds programmable sunrise, sunset and moonlight ramping to any Aurora bar. Plug between light and power.

  • Compatible: All Aurora LED bars
  • Channels: 4 independent
  • Ramp: 1-60 min sunrise/sunset
  • Memory: Retains settings after power cut

products.title: Aquascaping Tool Set - 5 Piece
products.body_html:
Stainless steel scaping set: straight tweezers, curved tweezers, spring scissors, curved scissors, and substrate spatula. Satin finish, 10in reach.

  • Pieces: 5
  • Material: 304 stainless steel
  • Length: 10 in (25 cm)
  • Finish: Matte satin, rust resistant
  • Includes: Roll-up storage case

products.title: Long-Reach Tweezers - 15in
products.body_html:
For deep tanks. 15in straight tweezers with serrated grip tips for planting stems without crushing them.

  • Length: 15 in (38 cm)
  • Material: 304 stainless steel
  • Tip: Serrated, fine point
  • Best for: Tanks over 18 in deep

products.title: Curved Spring Scissors
products.body_html:
Spring-loaded curved scissors for trimming carpet plants flush to the substrate without disturbing the scape.

  • Length: 10 in (25 cm)
  • Blade: Curved, spring return
  • Material: 304 stainless steel
  • Best for: Carpet and stem trimming

products.title: Magnetic Glass Cleaner - Float
products.body_html:
Floating magnetic scraper for glass up to 12mm. Blade attachment for stubborn spot algae. Floats free if it separates so it never gets buried.

  • Glass thickness: Up to 12 mm
  • Floats: Yes, self-surfacing
  • Blade: Detachable scraper
  • Grip: Non-scratch felt pad

products.title: 6-in-1 Tank Maintenance Kit
products.body_html:
Extendable-handle kit: gravel rake, sponge, scraper blade, net, and two brush heads on one telescoping shaft.

  • Handle: Telescoping, 15-31 in
  • Heads: 6 interchangeable
  • Material: Stainless + ABS
  • Storage: Hanging loop

products.title: Desktop CO2 System - Complete
products.body_html:
Everything except the gas: dual-gauge regulator with solenoid, bubble counter, check valve, diffuser and tubing. Connects to a standard paintball or CGA320 cylinder.

  • Regulator: Dual-gauge, integrated solenoid
  • Fitting: CGA320 + paintball adapter
  • Includes: Bubble counter, check valve, diffuser, 3 m tubing
  • Note: Cylinder not included, source locally
_specs: Bubble counter, check valve, diffuser, 3 m tubing

products.title: Dual-Gauge Regulator + Solenoid
products.body_html:
The regulator on its own. Precise needle valve, working and cylinder pressure gauges, solenoid for timer control.

  • Gauges: Working + cylinder pressure
  • Solenoid: 110-240 V, timer-ready
  • Fitting: CGA320
  • Adjustment: Fine needle valve

products.title: Inline Atomiser Diffuser - 16/22mm
products.body_html:
Inline atomiser for canister filter return lines. Produces a finer mist than in-tank ceramic, dissolving more CO2 before it reaches the surface.

  • Fits: 16/22 mm tubing
  • Body: Acrylic + ceramic core
  • Position: Inline, filter return
  • Working pressure: 30+ psi

products.title: Glass Drop Checker + 4dKH Solution
products.body_html:
Reads dissolved CO2 by colour. Green means you are in range. Ships with 4dKH reference solution and bromothymol indicator.

  • Reads: Green = ~30 ppm CO2
  • Includes: 4dKH solution + indicator
  • Mount: Suction cup, in-tank
  • Response: Colour shifts in 1-2 hr

products.title: Bubble Counter + Check Valve Set
products.body_html:
Glass bubble counter with integrated non-return valve. Lets you dial bubbles-per-second and stops water siphoning back into the regulator.

  • Body: Borosilicate glass
  • Valve: Integrated non-return
  • Fits: 4/6 mm CO2 tubing
  • Mount: Suction cup or inline

products.title: Aqua Soil - Planted Substrate 9L
products.body_html:
Nutrient-rich baked soil substrate for rooted plants. Buffers pH toward the acidic range that most aquarium plants and shrimp prefer.

  • Volume: 9 L (approx 20 lb)
  • Grain: 2-4 mm
  • Buffers: pH toward 6.5
  • Best for: Rooted stems, carpets, shrimp

products.title: Seiryu Stone - 11lb Hardscape Box
products.body_html:
Grey-blue Seiryu with sharp white veining. Boxed as a mixed-size set so you can build a full iwagumi layout from one order.

  • Weight: 11 lb (5 kg) mixed sizes
  • Pieces: 5-8 per box
  • Note: Raises hardness slightly
  • Best for: Iwagumi, mountain scapes

products.title: Spider Wood - Centrepiece Set
products.body_html:
Branching hardwood with fine tips, ideal for anchoring moss and epiphytes. Pre-soaked to shorten the sink time.

  • Pieces: 3 branching pieces
  • Size: 8-14 in each
  • Prep: Pre-soaked, low tannin
  • Best for: Moss, Anubias, Bucephalandra

products.title: Fine White Sand - 20lb
products.body_html:
Inert sugar-fine white sand. Neutral, will not shift pH, and shows off fish colour and shadow lines in a scape.

  • Weight: 20 lb (9 kg)
  • Grain: 0.5-1 mm
  • Chemistry: Inert, pH neutral
  • Best for: Foreground, corydoras, contrast

products.title: Master Water Test Kit - 5 in 1
products.body_html:
Liquid reagent kit for pH, ammonia, nitrite, nitrate and hardness. Liquid tests read more accurately than strips, especially at low ammonia.

  • Tests: pH, NH3, NO2, NO3, GH/KH
  • Type: Liquid reagent
  • Count: ~500 tests
  • Includes: Glass vials + colour card

products.title: Digital pH & TDS Meter
products.body_html:
Two-in-one pocket meter with automatic temperature compensation and calibration solutions included.

  • Reads: pH 0-14, TDS 0-9990 ppm
  • Accuracy: +/- 0.1 pH
  • Calibration: Auto, solutions included
  • Power: 2x LR44, included

products.title: Test Strips - 11 in 1, 100 Count
products.body_html:
Fast weekly check for eleven parameters. Use these between full liquid tests to spot a trend before it becomes a problem.

  • Parameters: 11
  • Count: 100 strips
  • Read time: 60 seconds
  • Best for: Weekly monitoring
